title: From Interaction to Mastery Prediction
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Learning Analytics
Knowledge Tracing
xAPI
Evidence Stream
Mastery Prediction
description: A p5.js step-through infographic of the six stages from a learner's action to a mastery prediction (action, xAPI statement, per-concept evidence stream, filter, BKT model, estimate and prediction), in which an assessment answer raises the estimate while a slider drag stops at the filter.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

educational.topic: The pipeline from learner interaction to mastery estimate and prediction
learningObjectives: The learner will explain what enters and leaves each stage between a learner's action and a mastery prediction, and identify which stage discards exposure evidence.
prerequisites: The three MicroSim verbs and the evidence classes (Chapter 16)
A mastery estimate as a probability (Chapter 18)

accessibility.notes: Radio buttons and buttons drive the step-through; stage cards are also reached by stepping; stopped events are marked in words and with a cross, not color alone

controls.label: Six pipeline stages
controls.purpose: Show a stage's definition, input, output and example

controls.label: Send
controls.purpose: Choose and send a sample event

controls.label: Send event / Next stage / Send another
controls.purpose: Move the sample event one stage along the chain

controls.label: Reset
controls.purpose: Clear the stream and return the estimate to 0.30

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Step-through worked example with concrete data at every stage
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click-to-inspect stages plus a step-through token for two contrasting events
keyQuestions: What enters and what leaves each stage?
Which stage discards exposure evidence, and why?
How does one correct answer change the estimate and the prediction?
commonMisconceptions: Slider drags and page time raise a mastery estimate
The estimate is the same thing as mastery
Every statement in the stream reaches the model
assessmentOpportunities: Writing the input and output of each stage
Explaining why the slider drag stops at the filter

simulation.model: Standard Bayesian knowledge tracing (conditioning then learning step)
assumptions: Illustrative parameters P(L0)=0.30, p_t=0.15, p_g=0.20, p_s=0.10, not fitted to data
The sample answer is always correct
